items.stem: Which statements about 0/1 knapsack dynamic programming are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: A 1D rolling array can replace the 2D table if the capacity loop runs in reverse
options.rationale: Correct: reverse iteration prevents reusing an item more than once.

options.text: Its time complexity is pseudo-polynomial, O(n*W)
options.rationale: Correct: it depends on the numeric capacity W, not just n.

options.text: It always runs in O(n log n)
Greedy by value/weight always gives the optimal 0/1 solution
options.rationale: False; that only works for the fractional knapsack.
